title: Technical Intern Training
docsTitle: Required Documents for Technical Intern Training
tips:
・Technical Intern Training visa allows foreigners to **learn skills and technology** through practical training in Japan

・Divided into **No.1 (up to 1 year)** and **No.2 (up to 2 additional years)** with different skill requirements

・Requires **supervising organization approval** and detailed training plan submission

・**Skill evaluation tests** are mandatory for progression from No.1 to No.2 status

・Check the latest requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)

> ⚠️ **Important:** This is a training program, not regular employment - specific labor protection rules apply
